evidence.detail: Launcher attaches this ActionListener to the JButton whose exact tooltip is 'Hide/show side panel'.
actionPerformed sets the exact client boolean side-panel toggle signal and performs no unrelated action.
The listener stores only the Launcher owner and is constructed only for that side-panel control button.

evidence.detail: Launcher constructs this MouseAdapter only for its TrayIcon and registers it through TrayIcon.addMouseListener.
mouseClicked obtains the launcher's JFrame, sets state NORMAL and makes the frame visible; no other mouse behavior or state exists.
The listener stores only its Launcher owner and is not shared with SwingUtil's separately recovered tray-icon listener.
